title: TEOS Instructional Unit
description: Machine-readable contract for a coherent, reusable grouping of Competencies and its ordered Session sequence. Instructional Units contain no institutional dates or meeting patterns.

instructional_unit_id.description: Stable identity unique within the Instructional Unit namespace.

version.description: The version of this Instructional Unit contract.

owner.description: The curriculum owner authoritative for this Instructional Unit.

title.description: The human-readable title of the Instructional Unit.

description.description: The instructional purpose and scope of the Unit.

included_competency_references.description: The non-empty collection of version-bound Competencies included in the Unit.

learning_objectives.description: Observable or assessable results intended for the Unit.

session_references.description: A non-empty ordered sequence of version-bound Sessions. Array order is educationally significant.

estimated_duration.description: The estimated instructional duration aggregated for the Unit.

assessment_strategy.description: The assessment and evidence strategy connected to included Competencies.

required_resources.description: Unit-level resource requirements that supplement rather than weaken Session requirements.

required_equipment.description: Unit-level equipment or tool-capability requirements without institutional inventory assignments.

required_safety_controls.description: Unit-level safety controls that supplement rather than weaken Session controls.

prerequisite_competency_references.description: Version-bound Competencies that must be satisfied before the Unit.

prerequisite_instructional_unit_referenc.description: Version-bound Instructional Units that must precede this Unit.

tags.description: Classification labels for the Instructional Unit.

maintainer.description: The organization responsible for maintaining this Unit.

revision_notes.description: A non-empty explanation of changes in this version.

lifecycle_status.description: The shared lifecycle state of the Instructional Unit.

metadata.description: Non-authoritative authorship, revision, and provenance metadata.

description.default: Develops the competencies required to establish safe working conditions.

learning_objectives.default: Apply the approved electrical safety process.

description.default: Observe the learner applying the full safety process.
